title: Room Grouping
description: The middle scale, and the one that actually gets designed. Nobody composes a house room by room; they compose it from clusters that have their own internal logic — a hall-and-parlor pair, a service core, a primary suite, a public enfilade, an entry sequence. A grouping is a reusable assembly of rooms with its own adjacency rules, its own servicing strategy, and its own rules for how it attaches to a massing. This is the layer the project brief called room groupings, and it is where a kit of parts becomes a plan.

scale.description: pair: two rooms with one relationship. cluster: three to six around a shared logic. core: a servicing or circulation nucleus. wing: a subordinate volume. sequence: an ordered path rather than a shape.

exceptions.description: Styles or massings where the rule does not hold. Same discipline as the fault corpus: a rule with no stated exceptions should be genuinely universal, and you should have checked.

measures.description: What this rule MEASURES, so that it can be held against the room record it constrains and against the rules of a grouping some parti carries alongside it. Added by oq/a-grouping-rule-and-a-room-record-can-disagree. A rule's `test` names variables (`piazza_depth_ft`) and a room record keys its bands by a different name (`width_ft`); nothing could join the two, so a grouping rule and the record it constrains could state different numbers for one quantity and nothing noticed. `room` and `band` join this rule to a room's own band; `quantity` and `units` join it to another grouping's rule. A rule with no `measures` is UNJUDGED -- build/check_grouping_rules.py reports it as could-not-compare, never as agreement. Optional, because the corpus predates it.

quantity.description: A short canonical name for the measured quantity. Where a proportion pack already names the same measure, USE THE PACK'S SPELLING -- two layers meaning one thing under two names is OQ 48 one layer out.

units.description: Deliberately NOT the proportion pack's units enum, which is closed at in/parts/modules/ratio/count and has no `ft`. Room bands are in feet and 761 pack rules depend on that enum, so the two vocabularies are kept apart rather than one being widened for the other. OQ 53: a quantity compared without its units has already produced two wrong dimensions in this corpus, so both are required together.

room.description: The room record whose band this rule constrains, where it constrains one. A building-level quantity (a ridge ratio, a facade fraction) states no room and is compared only against other grouping rules.

band.description: Which of that room's `dimensions` bands. Note `ceiling_min_ft` is a scalar floor rather than a two-element band, and the checker treats it accordingly.

advisory_band.description: A band that is REPORTED rather than required, for a rule whose quantity is a CONSEQUENCE of the design rather than an input to it. Added by oq/the-facade-is-a-result-not-an-input (WP-11.7): `centre-passage-core`'s facade-share rule sized the passage FROM the facade, which the ruling found backwards -- the passage takes a bay and its share of the front follows -- so the rule lost its `test` and its band lives here. It is the observed range for the type and the observation is real, which is why it is kept at all. **A rule carrying this must NOT also carry a `test` on the same quantity**: that would be requiring and reporting one number at once. The band is written HERE and nowhere else, so a reader (build/facade.py::facade_share) takes it from the record instead of transcribing it -- one spelling, which is the discipline this corpus keeps having to relearn.

reported_by.description: The reader that reports this quantity, `path::function`, for a rule that is a report rather than a requirement. It exists so that a rule with no `test` cannot read as a rule nobody executes -- `plan_check` emits `check by hand` for an untested HARD rule, and a REPORTED rule needs to say where its answer actually comes from instead.

attaches_to.description: How the grouping lands in a skeleton. This is the join between the room catalogue and the massing catalogue, and it is what makes the two composable.

expansion_logic.description: How the grouping grows without breaking — the property formal styles most conspicuously lack.

privacy_span.description: The privacy ranks this grouping spans, lowest to highest. A grouping that spans 2 to 5 with no buffer is a gradient failure waiting to happen.

name_in_style.description: What this grouping is called in that style — chambers, offices, the piazza. Naming is where most of the confusion in residential design lives.

circulation_parti.description: circulation partis this grouping is compatible with
